mapper.sql: t.id, t.user_id, u.user_name, t.file_id, t.file_name, t.mime_type, t.file_size, t.processing_requirement, t.analysis_requirement, t.status, t.processing_mode, t.model_name, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.request_id, t.version, t.started_at, t.completed_at, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT , t.file_url, t.analysis_text FROM file_analysis_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=t.user_id WHERE t.id=#{id}
SELECT t.* FROM file_analysis_task t WHERE t.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_analysis_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND file_id=#{fileId}
SELECT id FROM file_analysis_task WHERE status='NOT_STARTED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE file_analysis_task SET status='PROCESSING',processing_mode='AUTO',request_id=#{requestId},version=version+1, started_at=NOW(),completed_at=NULL,error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,worker_id=#{workerId},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='NOT_STARTED'
UPDATE file_analysis_task SET status='NOT_STARTED',started_at=NULL,version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND processing_mode='AUTO' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE file_analysis_task SET status='NOT_STARTED',started_at=NULL,version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND processing_mode='AUTO' AND worker_id=#{workerId}

UPDATE file_analysis_task SET status='NOT_STARTED',started_at=NULL,version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND processing_mode='AUTO' AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
